top_signals.title: September BOJ Hike May Be Insufficient to Boost Yen, Rabobank Says
top_signals.summary: "My gut feeling is they need more," says Jane Foley, head of FX strategy at Rabobank, when asked on Bloomberg Television about whether an interest-rate hike by the Bank of Japan at its next policy meeting will be enough to prompt yen appreciation. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
